branch_assignments.rationale: Embodied spatial intelligence benchmark centered on agent/world state.
Benchmark, data, leaderboard, and evaluation infrastructure for embodied video generation.

paper.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
paper.data: 4,856 QA pairs across 13 tasks from 1,646 real UAV videos (about 14.9 hours), with dual-expert verification and public code/data.
paper.method: Self-in-space hierarchy spanning spatial cognition, self-motion awareness, perception, memory, and reasoning, plus SIS-Motion optical-flow feature fusion.
paper.task: Evaluate whether video MLLMs jointly model external spatial structure and the UAV's own evolving motion/action state.
paper.novelty: Makes agent self-state explicit alongside environmental spatial cognition in aerial embodied evaluation.
paper.project_relevance: Provides reusable AgentState, MotionHistory, SpatialMemory, ActionPrediction, and PathPlanning evaluation fields.

paper.title: Rethinking Video Generation Model for the Embodied World
paper.data: RBench with 650 image-text cases across five tasks and four embodiments, plus RoVid-X with 4M annotated 720p clips over 1,300+ skills.
paper.method: Nine-indicator embodied video evaluation paired with a four-stage robot-video collection, filtering, segmentation, and annotation pipeline.
paper.task: Evaluate task correctness, physical plausibility, action completeness, and visual fidelity of robot-oriented video generators and provide training data.
paper.novelty: Couples a reproducible embodied video benchmark with a large multi-embodiment physically annotated training corpus and public leaderboard.
paper.project_relevance: Direct evaluator and data-source reference for generated physical-world consistency and action-aligned video.
